issues.title: Load login-shell environment when launched from Spotlight/Dock
issues.author: csaroff
issues.body:
I define some providers in `~/.pi/agent/models.json` with `"apiKey": "$MY_API_KEY"`, where the variable is exported in my zsh config. The pi CLI can use them, but when I open pi-gui from Spotlight or the Dock, all of those models show up under Settings → Models → Not connected, with no explanation. Launching the pi-gui binary from a terminal fixes it.

pi-gui already works around this for PATH (augmentPosixPath in main.ts). Could it load the login shell's environment at startup instead, the way VS Code does? Failing that, it would help if Settings showed which variable is missing.
